title: 第二十章 人榜第一第二十一章 我比归真高两层
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
数天后，最新一期的人榜出炉。
六扇门总部外的宽阔广场上，有一块块的照壁。不少武林人士围观于此，热闹纷纷，议论不断。亦有闲散无事的市井百姓聚了过来，看看今日的人榜会有什么变化。
没过多久，六扇门的捕快迈步行来，走到人榜照壁之前，刷刷几下干净利索的把前面几页全部撕掉，重新粘贴。
“这一次人榜变化这么大？”许多百姓愕然不已。平日不曾关注江湖之事，莫不是近日有人突然崛起，使得后面排名需得重新排列？
不同寻常百姓的愕然，一众的武林人士早有预料。
这几日过去，那一次‘无形剑’与‘归真返璞’对决结果使得江湖一片哗然。
人榜前十几位排名大变是可以猜想到的。
有的百姓望向贴好的榜单，本以为会一如既往的看到‘无形剑’何九的名字，没想到却是换了人。
“人榜第一换人了！”
“‘无形剑’难道突破外景了？”
接着看到排名的详细介绍，所有人都闭上了嘴。
“姓名：林阳。”
“年龄：廿一。”
“功法：不详，剑法掌法境界高深，有外景级雷性功法、身法。”
“战绩：于江东茂陵一招击败‘剑下无错’王绩，荒野斩杀半步外景‘江东之虎’，馗城外三招击败‘无形剑’何九。”
“排名：第一位。”
“绰号：归真返璞。通雷剑。”
“评价：外景之下第一高手。”
“身份：原江湖散修，馗城一战后被地榜第二的玄天宗掌门守静真人收入门下，现玄天宗嫡传。”
所有人都愣愣无言，有人复杂的开口道：“在击败‘无形剑’前，还击杀过半步外景，如不是人榜刊登，我等都不曾听闻。”

“或许等下一次人榜更新，这位第一就不在榜上了。”
有人推测待这段时日，林阳转修《天帝玉册》便会一步登天，成就外景，到时候自然脱离人榜的范畴。
接着又有人往下看去。
“第二名不是‘无形剑。’”
他惊呼出声，显得极为意外，本以为第二名会是曾经的第一。
“姓名：王思远”
“年龄：廿二。”
“功法：《算经》《堪虚剑法》”
“战绩：堪虚剑法大成，年初击败‘狼王’铁升。”
“排名：人榜第二”
“绰号：算尽苍生。”
“评价：算无遗策。”
“身份：江东王氏少主。”
“‘无形剑’何九于前日一步登天，内外交汇，成就外景。当时有天罚降临，为金风劫。”
content_en:
A few days later, the latest list of people was released.
In the wide square outside the six-door headquarters, there are blocks of screen walls. Many martial arts people gathered here to watch, and there was a lot of excitement and constant discussion. There were also idle people from the market gathered over to see what changes would be made in today's list of people.
Not long after, the six-door police officer walked up to the screen wall with the list of people, and with a few swipes, he tore off all the first few pages and re-pasted them.
"This time the list of people has changed so much?" Many people were shocked. I don't pay much attention to the affairs of the world on weekdays. Could it be that someone suddenly rose up recently, causing the subsequent rankings to be rearranged?
Unusually for the common people's astonishment, a group of martial arts people had already expected this.
In the past few days, the result of the duel between the 'Invisible Sword' and 'Return to True Nature' caused an uproar in the world.
It is conceivable that the rankings of the top ten people on the list have changed drastically.
Some people looked at the posted list, expecting to see the name of the 'Invisible Sword' He Jiu as always, but unexpectedly, there was a different person.
"The number one on the list has been changed!"
"Did the 'Invisible Sword' break through the exterior scene?"
After seeing the detailed introduction of the rankings, everyone shut their mouths.
"Name: Lin Yang."
"Age: twenty-one."
"Kung Fu: Unknown. The realm of swordsmanship and palm skills is advanced. There are outdoor-level thunder skills and body skills."
"Achievements: Defeated Wang Ji with one move in Maoling, Jiangdong. Killed "Tiger of Jiangdong" with half a step in the wilderness. Defeated "Invisible Sword" He Jiu with three moves outside Kuicheng."
"Ranking: No. 1."
"Nickname: Return to True Nature. Thunder Sword."
"Evaluation: The best in outdoor scenes."
"Identity: A former casual cultivator in the martial arts world. After the First World War in Kuicheng, he was taken under the tutelage of Master Shou Jing, the head of the Xuantian Sect, who was second on the list. He is now the direct descendant of the Xuantian Sect."
Everyone was stunned and speechless, and someone said complicatedly: "Before defeating the 'Invisible Sword', I also killed half a step outside. If it hadn't been published on the list, we would have never heard of it."
"Perhaps when the next list is updated, the number one person will no longer be on the list."
Some people speculate that during this period of time, Lin Yang will be able to reach the sky in one step by studying the "Jade Book of the Emperor of Heaven" and achieve success in outdoor scenes, and then he will naturally be out of the category of the list of people.
Then someone looked down again.
"Second place is not 'Invisible Sword.'"
He exclaimed, looking extremely surprised. He thought that the second place would be the former first place.
"Name: Wang Siyuan"
"Age: twenty-two."
"Skills: "Suan Jing" and "Kanxu Sword Technique"
"Achievements: Kanxu has perfected his swordsmanship and defeated the 'Wolf King' Tie Sheng at the beginning of the year."
"Ranking: Second on the list of people"
"Nickname: Count all the people."
"Evaluation: It's a perfect plan."
"Identity: Young Master of the Wang Family in Jiangdong."
"The 'Invisible Sword' He Jiu ascended to the sky in one step the day before yesterday, and the interior and exterior merged to achieve the exterior scene. At that time, a divine punishment came, which was the Golden Wind Tribulation."
